preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(l, int) and isinstance(r, int) and 1 <= l <= r <= 10**9 for l, r in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, l and r are integers such that 1 <= l <= r <= 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no', 'Yes', 'No'] for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a case-insensitive 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((exists_a(l, r) and line.strip().upper() == 'YES') or (not exists_a(l, r) and line.strip().upper() == 'NO') for line, (l, r) in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case (l, r), the output is 'YES' if there exists an integer a > r such that for every x in [l, r], x mod a >= a/2, and 'NO' otherwise.
